1) Tue Aug 24, 10:30–12:00 (90-min single block)
2) Wed Aug 25, 14:00–14:45 (controls & evidence) + Wed Aug 25, 15:00–15:45 (vendor Q&A)
3) Thu Aug 26, 09:00–10:30 (backup, 90-min)

If any of those look good I can send a calendar invite and share a Drive folder with the evidence pack. I've copied Grace (CS lead) and Kimberly (security product PM) who will join the call.
